items.item_text: Experience in food service, including tray assembly and meal delivery.

Under the direction of the Food and Nutrition Services team, the Food Service Worker supports patient meal service by preparing and maintaining assigned tray assembly stations, assembling and distributing patient meals, and providing courteous service to patients. Responsibilities include ensuring proper food handling and sanitation practices, maintaining clean and organized work areas, assisting patients with menu selections, and delivering meals and snacks according to established dietary guidelines.

The Food Service Worker may also collect and transport meal trays and food carts, maintain food service areas, and assist in the dishroom, potroom, and housekeeping duties as needed. The ability to work across all assigned tray assembly stations and adapt to various Food and Nutrition Services duties is required. Other duties may be assigned as needed.
Ability to read and write and follow oral and written instructions in English sufficient to identify food items and menu selections.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced tray assembly environment.
Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations without the use of a calculator.
Basic knowledge and understanding of various diets.
Strong interpersonal skills to interact effectively with co-workers, medical staff, patients, supervisors, and management.
Ability to adhere to department dress code requirements.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive activities, including stretching, bending, pushing, walking, lifting, and reaching.
Ability to lift and push heavy carts.
Ability to attend and participate in required departmental training classes.
